# Venturing Roundtables Archive

These materials were resources for traditional, face-to-face roundtables and
will remain available for a period of time. Check the [Roundtable Planning
Resources](https://www.scouting.org/commissioners/roundtable-
support/roundtable-planning-resources/) page frequently for new additions to
the contemporary materials provided there.
